entities.summary: Kevin Patrick Kiley is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for California's 3rd congressional district since 2023. Elected as a Republican, Kiley represented the 6th district in the California State Assembly from 2016 to 2022. Kiley was one of 53 candidates who unsuccessfully attempted to replace California governor Gavin Newsom in a recall election on September 14, 2021.
